scope: Research and implement a flexible project workflow and active simplification in Claude/Codex/Grok native profiles.

limits: Staged native overlays are not live installed wrapper behavior.
Local native protocol/loading tests do not establish cloud model judgment.
Grok natural trials did not deliver by the preset 180-second deadline; unchanged green baseline is not simplification success.
The earlier Codex explicit-role experiment predates the final baseline/routing correction; exact original snapshots and differences are preserved.
No finite experiment proves universal or globally optimal architecture/code quality.
Final Codex natural run used fork_turns=all and encrypted follow-up messages; it is not proof of strict noninherited review context.
Final model tests still fix some incidental choices; this workflow does not eliminate all model-created contracts.
